trickyParts: The migration is 0130, after main's 0129_document_edit_notices (renumbered from 0129 in the second forward merge, f530ab46). store's TestMigrationSetIsNumberedOneToN refuses a gap, so whichever of this pull request and INFRA-367's merges second renumbers its own migrations (agreed with INFRA-367's implementer on Envoy).

Same-document pointer targets are resolved from the rendered block offsets of the tree the write leaves (exactly what document_blocks will hold), other documents from document_blocks by node_id, any row of a disallowed type refusing (node_id is not unique).

The graph_edges block arm and the two direct block_refs reads filter `to_types is null or block_ref_listed(...)`, so mention rows (to_types null) never pay the function call, which Postgres cannot inline.

on conflict ... do update set to_types (instead of do nothing) requires the pair list to be unique per key: pointer pairs are deduplicated per (block, kind, target) and a block[] name can never be `mentions`.

CheckBlockPointers' resolver is func(ref) ([]string, error), not (type, found): node_id is not unique, so every current type is checked, and the database lookup returns its error.
